skill.name: nano-banana
skill.description: Generate and edit images with Gemini native image models through the inference.sh belt CLI.
skill.summary: Create, edit, and configure Gemini images from natural-language requests.
skill.author: inferen-sh

security_audit.summary: The skill legitimately invokes the belt CLI and remote Gemini image services, which can transmit prompts and source images externally. Most static findings are Markdown formatting, model identifiers, placeholder URLs, or documentation links without executable behavior.

remediation.issue: Prompts and source images are sent to external inference services.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before transmission and advise them not to submit confidential, regulated, or unlicensed content.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends remote skill installation through npx.
remediation.suggestion: Pin installation references to reviewed versions or immutable commits and require user confirmation before installation.

remediation.issue: Generated images and grounded searches may consume paid service credits.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm model, image count, resolution, and search grounding before running billable commands.

content.user_title: Generate and Edit Images with Gemini
content.value_statement: Creating consistent images requires model selection and precise command inputs. This skill prepares and runs Gemini image workflows through the inference.sh CLI.
actual_capabilities: Generates images from text prompts with supported Gemini image models.
Edits an existing image from a supplied image URL and instruction.
Requests multiple image variations in one operation.
Configures aspect ratio, resolution, and output format.
Enables Google Search grounding for current information.
Creates sample input files for configurable CLI workflows.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI, authentication, and network access.
Model access, pricing, speed, and output quality depend on external services.
Source images must be accessible to the remote service.
The skill does not verify copyright, privacy, or factual accuracy.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate several branded concepts with defined colors, composition, and aspect ratios.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Mockups
use_cases.description: Edit product images by changing backgrounds, lighting, or surrounding elements.

use_cases.title: Prototype Editorial Art
use_cases.description: Produce high-resolution illustrations grounded in current information for review.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a photorealistic image of [subject] in [setting] with [lighting]. Use a square aspect ratio.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create one simple image from a text description.

prompt_templates.title: Create Multiple Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Create four logo concepts for [brand] using [colors] and a minimalist style. Use the Gemini 2.5 Flash Image model.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Source Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [image URL] by adding [change] while preserving composition, identity, and lighting. Return one image in 16:9 format.
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply a controlled change to an existing image.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Grounded 4K Scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Gemini 3 Pro Image to create a 4K [aspect ratio] scene grounded in current information about [topic].
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce a detailed visual using search grounding.

output_examples.input: Create four minimalist coffee shop logos in black and green.
output_examples.output: Four distinct logo images with consistent colors, clean shapes, and simple typography.

output_examples.input: Add a rainbow to the supplied landscape while preserving its lighting.
output_examples.output: An edited landscape with a naturally integrated rainbow and unchanged composition.

output_examples.input: Create a 4K panoramic illustration of a castle under dramatic evening light.
output_examples.output: A detailed panoramic castle scene with dramatic shadows and high-resolution output.

best_practices: Confirm the selected model, image count, resolution, and expected cost before execution.
Describe subject, style, composition, lighting, colors, and required details explicitly.
Use only source images that may be lawfully transmitted to external services.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential images, personal data, credentials, or private URLs.
Do not enable search grounding when current information is unnecessary.
Do not request high resolution or multiple images before validating the prompt.

faq.question: Which models does this skill support?
faq.answer: It documents Gemini 3 Pro Image and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image applications available through inference.sh.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an accessible image URL and describe the required change.

faq.question: Can it generate several images?
faq.answer: Yes. Set the requested image count when the selected model supports multiple outputs.

faq.question: Does it support 4K output?
faq.answer: The documented Gemini 3 Pro Image application accepts 1K, 2K, and 4K resolution options.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Yes. The belt CLI sends requests and content to external inference services.

faq.question: Is source image content private?
faq.answer: No local privacy guarantee is provided. Review service policies before sending sensitive or regulated content.
